categories.main_business_segments: Laplace Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance thermal processing, coating, and supporting automation equipment for new high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) cells and semiconductor discrete devices. The company also provides related parts, equipment maintenance, and upgrade services. Its product lines cover core process equipment for PV cell manufacturing, including diffusion, coating, and automation systems, as well as semiconductor device equipment such as oxidation, annealing, and coating devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies such as low-pressure horizontal boron diffusion, large-capacity LPCVD (Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition), precise heating and temperature control, high-temperature gas-phase reaction with horizontal wafer placement, uniform gas flow and precise gas control, and special photovoltaic materials application. It also develops third-generation semiconductor ultra-high temperature oxidation annealing technology and intelligent automatic loading/unloading systems. The production is mainly customized based on sales orders, employing 'make-to-order' manufacturing with strong R&D capabilities and a platform-based product development approach.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Laplace serves leading photovoltaic cell manufacturers and semiconductor device producers, including major clients like LONGi Green Energy, JinkoSolar, Aiko Solar, Zhonglai, and others in the PV industry. Its products support the production of high-efficiency N-type PV cells such as TOPCon and XBC technologies. The company’s customer base is concentrated, with the top five customers accounting for over 76% of sales, primarily in the renewable energy and semiconductor sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with subsidiaries and operations in key regions including Shenzhen, Wuxi, Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Xi'an, and overseas entities in Hong Kong and Singapore. Its sales cover domestic markets and international markets, notably Southeast Asia, with overseas sales growing significantly. The company maintains a global outlook with active participation in international industry exhibitions and market expansion efforts.
categories.supply_chain_position: Laplace operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic and semiconductor supply chains, focusing on manufacturing and supplying core process equipment and automation solutions essential for PV cell and semiconductor device production. It provides critical manufacturing equipment that enables downstream producers to fabricate high-efficiency cells and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in core process technologies such as thermal processing, coating, and automation for PV and semiconductor equipment. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on emerging technologies like TOPCon, XBC, HJT, perovskite, and tandem cells. Strategic R&D projects include developing new generation thermal components, low-maintenance exhaust systems, high-efficiency clean systems, ultra-high temperature vacuum sealing, and advanced coating platforms. It also emphasizes talent development, digital R&D management, and collaboration with top research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Laplace generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialized equipment and related services, including parts supply, maintenance, and equipment upgrades. The company follows a direct sales model, securing orders via bidding and direct client engagement. Revenue is recognized upon delivery, customer acceptance, and receipt of payment, reflecting the customized nature of its products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Laplace is positioned as a leading domestic supplier and innovator in high-efficiency photovoltaic cell core process equipment and semiconductor discrete device equipment. It holds a strong market position in China’s PV equipment manufacturing industry, recognized as a national 'Manufacturing Single Champion' for its low-pressure horizontal boron diffusion system. The company competes by leveraging advanced technology, comprehensive product lines, and close collaboration with leading PV cell manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Laplace achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.73 billion, representing a 93.12% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached about RMB 729 million, up 77.53% from the previous year. The company’s total assets were around RMB 10.1 billion, with net assets increasing by nearly 68%. It maintains a robust growth trajectory supported by strong R&D investment (5.16% of revenue) and expanding market demand for high-efficiency PV equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Laplace emphasizes its technological leadership and innovation in core PV cell manufacturing processes, offering highly efficient, reliable, and cost-effective equipment tailored to emerging high-efficiency cell technologies like TOPCon and XBC. Its proprietary low-pressure horizontal boron diffusion technology and large-capacity LPCVD solutions address industry bottlenecks, improving cell efficiency and production yield. The company’s integrated solutions, strong patent portfolio, and customer-centric approach provide differentiated value by enabling clients to achieve advanced cell performance and scalable production.
